name: The ATLAS Experiment at the CERN Large Hadron Collider

summary.plain: The collaboration's own full description of the finished ATLAS detector, published as the LHC was about to start.
summary.technical: 2008 JINST 3 S08003: the standard ATLAS detector-paper reference, describing the inner detector, calorimeters, muon spectrometer, magnet system and trigger as installed for first collisions.
